name: hud_sensor_tracker_load_map_from_stream
description: Reads a versioned map stream, loads serialized map nodes, inserts them into the tracker, and marks the map loaded.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent HudSensorTracker/map.cpp source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja shows VC5 EH bookkeeping that reuses the stream argument stack slot for the allocated node pointer; this is treated as tier S debt, not a functional difference.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4168d0 validates null-stream failure, version/header/bounds reads, version error reporting, node allocation/init/load loop, failed terminal node cleanup, mapLoadedFlag assignment, and return values; the native smoke covers a successful serialized map load through the path wrapper.
